transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Lately, I've been having these intense thoughts that people are watching me and trying to harm me. I'm also convinced that random things happening around me are actually secret messages meant just for me, and I can't seem to shake these beliefs.
Have you also been experiencing significant changes in your mood, such as periods of extreme energy and feeling 'on top of the world,' or conversely, long periods of deep sadness and hopelessness?

Yes, for about the past eight months, I've felt incredibly energized and on top of the world, like I have an endless amount of vitality. However, I haven't experienced any of those periods of deep sadness or hopelessness.

During these past eight months when you felt this high energy, were the thoughts about people watching you or secret messages present at the same time, or did those thoughts only occur during other periods?

Yes, during those eight months of high energy, I definitely experienced those thoughts of being watched and seeing secret messages. But they weren't limited to that time; there was a period of about two or three weeks when my energy returned to normal, yet I still felt monitored and kept seeing those messages.
During that two-week period when your mood and energy levels were normal, were the delusions about being watched and the secret messages still just as intense as they were when your energy was high?

Yes, they were absolutely just as intense. Even though my mood and energy had returned to normal, I still strongly believed I was being watched and kept seeing those secret messages. Those thoughts felt completely real to me, even without the high energy.

Besides these thoughts about being watched and secret messages, have you noticed any other changes in your thinking, such as feeling like your thoughts are being broadcast out loud or that people can hear what you are thinking?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't feel like my thoughts are being broadcast out loud or that other people can hear what I'm thinking.
Are you experiencing any other symptoms, such as hearing voices talking to you when no one is around or seeing things that others cannot see?

Yes, I've actually been hearing whispering voices when I'm completely alone in my room, which is really frightening. I've also seen shadowy figures moving around that others say aren't there. It's incredibly confusing and makes me feel like I can't trust my own senses.

Looking back over the last year, has the total amount of time you spent in that high-energy state been a significant portion of your overall illness, compared to the time you've spent experiencing these voices and visions?

Yes, that high-energy state has definitely been a major part of my overall illness. It has lasted for about eight months, which is actually longer than the six months I've been dealing with the voices and visions.
During the times when your mood and energy were normal, did you experience these voices and visions, or were they only present while you were in that high-energy state?

Yes, I definitely experienced them even when my mood and energy were completely normal. There was a period of at least a couple of weeks where I felt emotionally stable, but I still heard those whispering voices and saw the shadowy figures.
